about: English specs and build status of the decided changes, by decision-page row. tools/build_list.py merges this into docs/build-list.json. A part is todo until built, done when built, lab-checked once a disposable lab install checked it (docs/evidence), later when it is only a possible later change on Christopher's list.

Haste and Slow cancel each other across spells and items as in SCS (haste_cancels_slow.tpa): Haste on a slowed target displays 'Slow cancelled by Haste', removes the Slow (sectype cbm_Slow), and does not start Haste or its fatigue; Slow on a hasted target displays 'Haste cancelled by Slow', removes the Haste (sectype cbm_Haste), and does not start Slow. Haste stays vanilla in every other way (bonus, duration, fatigue).

Improved Haste (SPWI613 and scroll SCRL7Q) becomes the party buff of Spell Revisions, built cleanly without opcode 16 so there is no second speed clock: keeps all 9 ability headers (min_level 1, 13..20), Area target (4), range 30, casting time 6, party-friendly 15-ft radius projectile 158 (INAREAPA), duration 1 turn (60s), dispellable (sectype 13 NON-COMBAT, resist_dispel 3), granting +6 movement rate (opcode 176), +1 APR (opcode 1, CBTAPR), +2 THAC0 (opcode 54), +2 AC (opcode 0), +2 Saving Throws vs. Breath (opcode 36), curing any active Slow (opcode 221 cbm_Slow + opcode 240 icon 41), granting immunity to Slow for 60s (opcode 101 p2=40, opcode 169 p2=41, opcode 267 strings, opcode 206 against Slow spells, and HASTE_IMMUNITY splstate blocking extracted Slow subspells), and preventing stacking with Haste and itself.

parts.spec: M_CBMP1.lua intercepts petrification and Imprisonment on Player1 while a living companion remains, allowing recovery via Stone to Flesh / Greater Restoration or Freedom, preserving area travel, rest dreams, and cold save reloads, and running a 30-second combat-paused dead-end clock when no companion can rescue Player1.
